content:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Lint workflows
        run: bash <(curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhysd/actionlint/v1.7.7/scripts/download-actionlint.bash) 1.7.7 && ./actionlint -color
      - uses: pnpm/setup@v2
        with:
          runtime: node@24
          cache: true
          install: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec vp check
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm pack:smoke

  publish:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/setup@v2
        with:
          runtime: node@24
          cache: true
          install: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Publish if this version is new
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "npm $(npm --version) at $(command -v npm)"
          case "$(npm --version)" in
            10.*|9.*)
              echo "need npm >= 11.5.1 for GitHub OIDC"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          VERSION="$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version)")"
          if npm view "comprehende@${VERSION}" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "comprehende@${VERSION} is already on npm — skipping publish"
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! npm view comprehende name >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "comprehende is not on npm yet. First publish is manual: pnpm publish --access public"
            echo "Then add a GitHub Actions trusted publisher for workflow ci.yml"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Publishing comprehende@${VERSION}"
          npm publish --access public
